title: Ordered context and opaque continuation need explicit fresh or append composition
trigger: ordered roles developer system native continuation flattened instructions duplicate history prefix cache phase
guidance: Keep one ordered text representation and map it before exact preparation, counting and admission. A role enum alone does not preserve role semantics when serializers and continuation bindings flatten instruction channels. Ordered continuation must retain its original native input/output prefix and explicitly append only new items; rebuilding earlier context requires a fresh complete frame, not a promise of preserved reasoning. Preserve supplied phase and cache boundaries, reject unsupported routes explicitly, and keep source interpretation host-owned. Immutable text records avoid introducing nested mutable projection state.

evidence.note: Ordered v2 carriers are mode-bound; legacy v1 remains distinct. New fields are opt-in and unsupported route mappings reject explicitly.
